newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tsang sees no reason to reduce corporate tax.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tsang sees no reason to reduce corporate tax.

text.p: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Wednesday he saw no reason to reduce corporate tax rates as they were already low.
"We have the lowest corporate profit tax among all developed economies and the maximum profit tax payment is now set at 16.5 percent," Tsang told CNN in an interview monitored in Hong Kong.
"Effective tax rate...is about eight to nine percent so we are highly competitive. That is no reason for us to reduce further," Tsang said.
Tsang also said the government would do more to tackle the territory's atrociously high property prices.
"On the land supply side, we are definitely going to do a lot more than before," he said.
"We are going to release about 46 percent more land in the coming five years compared with the previous five years."
